verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Depois disse o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Dize a Arão e a seus filhos que se abstenham das coisas sagradas dos filhos de Israel, as quais eles a mim me santificam, e que não profanem o meu santo nome. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Give orders to Aaron and to his sons to keep themselves separate from the holy things of the children of Israel which they give to me, and not to make my holy name common: I am the Lord,

verses.en: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Dize-lhes: Todo homem dentre os vossos descendentes pelas vossas gerações que, tendo sobre si a sua imundícia, se chegar às coisas sagradas que os filhos de Israel santificam ao Senhor, aquela alma será extirpada da minha presença. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things, which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Say to them, If any man of all your seed through all your generations, being unclean, comes near the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the Lord, he will be cut off from before me: I am the Lord.

verses.en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
verses.pt: Ninguém dentre os descendentes de Arão que for leproso, ou tiver fluxo, comerá das coisas sagradas, até que seja limpo. Também o que tocar em alguma coisa tornada imunda por causa e um morto, ou aquele de quem sair o sêmem
verses.en_web: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose offspring goes from him;
verses.en_bbe: No man of the seed of Aaron who is a leper, or who has a flow from his body, may take of the holy food till he is clean. And any man touching anything which is unclean because of the dead, or any man whose seed goes from him;

verses.en: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.pt: ou qualquer que tocar em algum animal que se arrasta, pelo qual se torne imundo, ou em algum homem, pelo qual se torne imundo, seja qual for a sua imundícia,
verses.en_web: or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;
verses.en_bbe: Or anyone touching any unclean thing which goes flat on the earth, or someone by whom he may be made unclean in any way whatever;

verses.en: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
verses.pt: o homem que tocar em tais coisas será imundo até a tarde, e não comerá das coisas sagradas, mas banhará o seu corpo em água
verses.en_web: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathes his body in water.
verses.en_bbe: Any person touching any such unclean thing will be unclean till evening, and may not take of the holy food till his flesh has been bathed in water;

verses.en: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
verses.pt: e, posto o sol, então será limpo; depois comerá das coisas sagradas, porque isso é o seu pão.
verses.en_web: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
verses.en_bbe: And when the sun has gone down he will be clean; and after that he may take part in the holy food, because it is his bread.

verses.en: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Do animal que morrer por si, ou do que for dilacerado por feras, não comerá o homem, para que não se contamine com ele. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: That which dies of itself, or is torn by animals, he shall not eat, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: That which comes to a natural death, or is attacked by beasts, he may not take as food, for it will make him unclean: I am the Lord.

verses.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.pt: Guardarão, pois, o meu mandamento, para que, havendo-o profanado, não levem pecado sobre si e morram nele. Eu sou o Senhor que os santifico.
verses.en_web: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
verses.en_bbe: So then, let them keep what I have put into their care, for fear that sin may come on them because of it, so causing their death because they have made it common: I am the Lord, who make them holy.

verses.en: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.pt: Também nenhum estranho comerá das coisas sagradas; nem o hóspede do sacerdote, nem o jornaleiro, comerá delas.
verses.en_web: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.en_bbe: No outside person may take of the holy food, or one living as a guest in the priest's house, or a servant working for payment.

verses.en: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
verses.pt: Mas aquele que o sacerdote tiver comprado com o seu dinheiro, e o nascido na sua casa, esses comerão do seu pão.
verses.en_web: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.
verses.en_bbe: But any person for whom the priest has given money, to make him his, may take of it with him; and those who come to birth in his house may take of his bread.

verses.en: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
verses.pt: Se a filha de um sacerdote se casar com um estranho, ela não comerá da oferta alçada das coisas sagradas.
verses.en_web: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
verses.en_bbe: And if the daughter of a priest is married to an outside person she may not take of the holy things which are lifted up as offerings.

verses.en: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
verses.pt: Mas quando a filha do sacerdote for viúva ou repudiada, e não tiver filhos, e houver tornado para a casa de seu pai, como na sua mocidade, do pão de seu pai comerá; mas nenhum estranho comerá dele.
verses.en_web: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread: but no stranger shall eat any of it.
verses.en_bbe: But if a priest's daughter is a widow, or parted from her husband, and has no child, and has come back to her father's house as when she was a girl, she may take of her father's bread; but no outside person may do so.

verses.en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
verses.pt: Se alguém por engano comer a coisa sagrada, repô-la-á, acrescida da quinta parte, e a dará ao sacerdote como a coisa sagrada.
verses.en_web: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man takes the holy food in error, he will have to give the holy thing back to the priest, with the addition of a fifth part.

verses.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
verses.pt: Assim não profanarão as coisas sagradas dos filhos de Israel, que eles oferecem ao Senhor,
verses.en_web: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,
verses.en_bbe: And they may not make common the holy things which the children of Israel give to the Lord,

verses.en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.pt: nem os farão levar sobre si a iniqüidade que envolve culpa, comendo as suas coisas sagradas; pois eu sou o Senhor que as santifico.
verses.en_web: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt, when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”
verses.en_bbe: So causing sin to come on them when they take their holy things for food: I am the Lord who make them holy.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
verses.pt: Fala a Arão, e a seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Todo homem da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros em Israel, que oferecer a sua oferta, seja dos seus votos, seja das suas ofertas voluntárias que oferecerem ao Senhor em holocausto,
verses.en_web: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows, or any of their freewill offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering;
verses.en_bbe: Say to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel, If any man of the children of Israel, or of another nation living in Israel, makes an offering, given because of an oath or freely given to the Lord for a burned offering;

verses.en: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.pt: para que sejais aceitos, oferecereis macho sem defeito, ou dos novilhos, ou dos cordeiros, ou das cabras.
verses.en_web: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.en_bbe: So that it may be pleasing to the Lord, let him give a male, without any mark, from among the oxen or the sheep or the goats.

verses.en: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.pt: Nenhuma coisa, porém, que tiver defeito oferecereis, porque não será aceita a vosso favor.
verses.en_web: But whatever has a defect, that you shall not offer; for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.en_bbe: But anything which has a mark you may not give; it will not make you pleasing to the Lord.

verses.en: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.pt: E, quando alguém oferecer sacrifício de oferta pacífica ao Senhor para cumprir um voto, ou para oferta voluntária, seja do gado vacum, seja do gado miúdo, o animal será perfeito, para que seja aceito; nenhum defeito haverá nele.
verses.en_web: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
verses.en_bbe: And whoever makes a peace-offering to the Lord, in payment of an oath or as a free offering, from the herd or the flock, if it is to be pleasing to the Lord, let it be free from any mark or damage.

verses.en: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
verses.pt: O cego, ou quebrado, ou aleijado, ou que tiver úlceras, ou sarna, ou impigens, estes não oferecereis ao Senhor, nem deles poreis oferta queimada ao Senhor sobre o altar.
verses.en_web: Blind, injured, maimed, having a wart, festering, or having a running sore: you shall not offer these to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Anything blind or broken or damaged or having any disease or any mark on it may not be offered to the Lord; you may not make an offering of it by fire on the altar to the Lord.

verses.en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.pt: Todavia, um novilho, ou um cordeiro, que tenha algum membro comprido ou curto demais, poderás oferecer por oferta voluntária, mas para cumprir voto não será aceito.
verses.en_web: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.en_bbe: An ox or a lamb which has more or less than its natural parts, may be given as a free offering; but it will not be taken in payment of an oath.

verses.en: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
verses.pt: Não oferecereis ao Senhor um animal que tiver testículo machucado, ou moído, ou arrancado, ou lacerado; não fareis isso na vossa terra.
verses.en_web: You must not offer to Yahweh that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
verses.en_bbe: An animal which has its sex parts damaged or crushed or broken or cut, may not be offered to the Lord; such a thing may not be done anywhere in your land.

verses.en: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.pt: Nem da mão do estrangeiro oferecereis de alguma dessas coisas o pão do vosso Deus; porque a sua corrupção nelas está; há defeito nelas; não serão aceitas a vosso favor.
verses.en_web: You must not offer the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner as any of these; because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
verses.en_bbe: And from one who is not an Israelite you may not take any of these for an offering to the Lord; for they are unclean, there is a mark on them, and the Lord will not be pleased with them.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.pt: Quando nascer um novilho, ou uma ovelha, ou uma cabra, por sete dias ficará debaixo de sua mãe; depois, desde o dia oitavo em diante, será aceito por oferta queimada ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: “When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is born, then it shall remain seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: When an ox or a sheep or a goat is given birth, let it be with its mother for seven days; and after the eighth day it may be taken as an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.en: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
verses.pt: Também, seja vaca ou seja ovelha, não a imolareis a ela e à sua cria, ambas no mesmo dia.
verses.en_web: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
verses.en_bbe: A cow or a sheep may not be put to death with its young on the same day.

verses.en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
verses.pt: E, quando oferecerdes ao Senhor sacrifício de ação de graças, oferecê-lo-eis de modo a serdes aceitos.
verses.en_web: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
verses.en_bbe: And when you make an offering of praise to the Lord, make it in a way which is pleasing to him.

verses.en: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: No mesmo dia se comerá; nada deixareis ficar dele até pela manhã. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Let it be used for food on the same day; do not keep any part of it till the morning: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Guardareis os meus mandamentos, e os cumprireis. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So then, keep my orders and do them: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
verses.pt: Não profanareis o meu santo nome, e serei santificado no meio dos filhos de Israel. Eu sou o Senhor que vos santifico,
verses.en_web: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,
verses.en_bbe: And do not make my holy name common; so that it may be kept holy by the children of Israel: I am the Lord who make you holy,

verses.en: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: que vos tirei da terra do Egito para ser o vosso Deus. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: Who took you out of the land of Egypt that I might be your God: I am the Lord.
